notes:
DraStic got a full pass from your reports, and this update is mostly that.

Controls first: DraStic shipped with a generic Xbox style mapping, which on Switch pads put
its own menu on right stick right, swapped X with Y and Start with Select, and left the
d-pad dead. Your controller maps properly now, and the launcher's button remapper applies to
DraStic the same way it already did for melonDS. Save state, Load state and Fast-forward in
the pause menu work; all three did nothing before. Pausing is reliable too, where unlucky
timing could previously freeze the emulator for good.

The touch screen behaved like a laptop trackpad: you had to drag the stylus icon onto a
button and then tap it. Taps now land where you touch, the moment you touch. The optional
stick pointer moved to the right stick with R3 to tap, and turning it off actually turns it
off.

Docked dual screen for DS now shows the right screens on the right displays, and the stray
cursor that wandered around the TV picture is gone.

Also: controllers work in standalone PPSSPP, which ignored them completely, and a controller
connected while another one is already active now gets its setup prompt instead of being
silently ignored.

Known rough edges: the DraStic controls are verified by automated on-console tests but not
yet by hand on real pads, PPSSPP's own pause menu rows are still unverified, and undocking
mid game on DS dual screen has not been cycled by hand.
